lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso, approximately 45-60 pixels between lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation observed at the dorsal terminus of the 6th vertical stripe (counting from posterior).
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Stripe 1 (most posterior) and Stripe 10 (most anterior) terminate prematurely; Stripe 4 exhibits a visible discontinuity/break in the mid-torso region.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 3 distinct white spots located on the posterior haunch: two in a lower horizontal pairing and one situated in the mid-thigh region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two lowest spots on the posterior haunch demonstrate a horizontal geometric alignment.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate silhouette with a dorsal-posterior trajectory curving inward toward the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping comprises approximately 12% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white V-shaped facial chevron, two distinct white malar spots on the snout, and a long orange-brown fringe along the ventral line.
